description: Model, measure and verify parametric parts and assemblies in a running SolidWorks (Windows).

tool_signatures.name: activate_document
tool_signatures.description: Make an open document current again by its title, also a new one that was never saved.

tool_signatures.name: add_boss_on_face
tool_signatures.description: Grow a round boss (standoff, peg) height_mm out of ANY planar face, centred at (x, y, z) mm.

tool_signatures.name: add_box
tool_signatures.description: Add a rectangular block: sketch width x height on the first plane, extrude by depth.

tool_signatures.name: add_chamfer
tool_signatures.description: Chamfer edges of the current part: distance_mm back along a face, at angle_deg (default 45°) to it.

tool_signatures.name: add_circular_pattern
tool_signatures.description: Repeat a feature `count` times evenly around 360° about an axis.

tool_signatures.name: add_cone
tool_signatures.description: Create a cone/frustum by revolving a trapezoidal profile 360°.

tool_signatures.name: add_counterbore_hole
tool_signatures.description: Cut a counterbored screw hole on the +Z face at (x_mm, y_mm).

tool_signatures.name: add_cylinder
tool_signatures.description: Create a cylinder by revolving a profile 360° about an axis.

tool_signatures.name: add_disc
tool_signatures.description: Create a disc/puck/flange: a circle extruded along +Z, centred at (x_mm, y_mm).

tool_signatures.name: add_extruded_profile
tool_signatures.description: Extrude a closed polygon into a solid: points_mm = [[x,y], ...] in mm.

tool_signatures.name: add_extruded_profile_on_face
tool_signatures.description: Grow a polygon boss depth_mm out of ANY planar face: points_mm = [[x,y,z], ...] in mm.

tool_signatures.name: add_extruded_profile_on_plane
tool_signatures.description: Extrude a polygon drawn on a reference plane, such as one add_plane made at an angle.

tool_signatures.name: add_extruded_slot
tool_signatures.description: Extrude a stadium (rounded tab, lug or link) from point start_mm to end_mm ([x, y] mm).

tool_signatures.name: add_extruded_spline
tool_signatures.description: Extrude a smooth CLOSED spline through points: points_mm = [[x,y], ...] in mm.

tool_signatures.name: add_fillet
tool_signatures.description: Round edges of the current part with one constant radius (mm).

tool_signatures.name: add_full_round
tool_signatures.description: Round a rib's top off completely: a full round fillet, as on a moulded part.

tool_signatures.name: add_hole
tool_signatures.description: Cut a circular through-hole at (x_mm, y_mm), through the part's depth axis.

tool_signatures.name: add_hole_on_face
tool_signatures.description: Drill a round hole on ANY planar face, centred at 3D point (x, y, z) mm.

tool_signatures.name: add_hole_wizard
tool_signatures.description: An ISO hole from SolidWorks' Hole Wizard, sized by its standard tables.

tool_signatures.name: add_linear_pattern
tool_signatures.description: Repeat a feature `count` times, `spacing_mm` apart, along a direction.

tool_signatures.name: add_lofted_solid
tool_signatures.description: Loft (blend) 2+ closed profiles on parallel planes stacked along +Z.

tool_signatures.name: add_mate
tool_signatures.description: Mate a face of one component to a face of another.

tool_signatures.name: add_mirror
tool_signatures.description: Mirror features, or the whole body, about the 'front'/'top'/'right' plane moved offset_mm.

tool_signatures.name: add_plane
tool_signatures.description: Make a reference plane to sketch on: an offset or a turned plane, its position a dimension.

tool_signatures.name: add_revolved_profile
tool_signatures.description: Revolve a closed profile on the Front plane about an axis in it.

tool_signatures.name: add_rib
tool_signatures.description: Add a straight stiffening rib / gusset in a plane parallel to the Front plane.

tool_signatures.name: add_shell
tool_signatures.description: Hollow the current part to a wall of thickness_mm, opening one face.

tool_signatures.name: add_sketch
tool_signatures.description: Draw a sketch of lines, arcs and splines on a plane, fully defined, to extrude or cut.

tool_signatures.name: add_swept_pipe
tool_signatures.description: Sweep a circular profile (pipe/tube/rod) along a 2D path on the Front plane.

tool_signatures.name: add_swept_profile
tool_signatures.description: Sweep an arbitrary closed PROFILE (cross-section) along a 2D PATH.

tool_signatures.name: add_text_on_face
tool_signatures.description: Engrave text into ANY planar face, or emboss it with emboss=True (labels, version numbers).

tool_signatures.name: add_thread
tool_signatures.description: Cut a real, printable ISO metric thread (SolidWorks' own Thread feature).

tool_signatures.name: check_interference
tool_signatures.description: Report component pairs whose solids overlap, with the volume in mm^3.

tool_signatures.name: check_motion
tool_signatures.description: Step a joint through its range and check the assembly at every step.

tool_signatures.name: check_printability
tool_signatures.description: Check the current part for 3D printing, built along `up` ('+z', '-y', ...).

tool_signatures.name: close_part
tool_signatures.description: Close the current part or assembly without saving (export/save first if needed).

tool_signatures.name: combine_bodies
tool_signatures.description: Combine solid bodies of the part into `main` (a list_bodies name).

tool_signatures.name: compare_with_mesh
tool_signatures.description: Compare the current part's cross-sections with a reference mesh's at the same heights.

tool_signatures.name: cut_offset_pocket
tool_signatures.description: Pocket a planar face, leaving a rim rim_mm wide along its outline.

tool_signatures.name: cut_profile
tool_signatures.description: Cut a polygonal pocket/slot from the +Z face: points_mm = [[x,y], ...] in mm.

tool_signatures.name: cut_profile_on_face
tool_signatures.description: Cut a polygon pocket/slot on ANY planar face: points_mm = [[x,y,z], ...] in mm.

tool_signatures.name: cut_profile_through_plane
tool_signatures.description: Cut a polygon sketched on a reference plane, symmetric about that plane.

tool_signatures.name: cut_sketch
tool_signatures.description: Cut an existing sketch of the current part by name into the body.

tool_signatures.name: cut_slot
tool_signatures.description: Cut a straight slotted hole (obround) on the +Z face.

tool_signatures.name: delete_component
tool_signatures.description: Remove a component from the current assembly, with the mates that hold it.

tool_signatures.name: delete_equation
tool_signatures.description: Delete an equation by the name it sets ("L_thigh", "D1@Boss") or its list_equations index.

tool_signatures.name: delete_feature
tool_signatures.description: Delete a feature (a list_features name) with its sketch, then rebuild and remeasure.

tool_signatures.name: delete_mate
tool_signatures.description: Delete a mate of the current assembly by name (list_components, or add_mate's 'mate').

tool_signatures.name: export
tool_signatures.description: Export the current part or assembly to STEP/STL/IGES/Parasolid/3MF (format from extension).

tool_signatures.name: extrude_sketch
tool_signatures.description: Extrude an existing sketch of the current part by name, e.g. one a person drew.

tool_signatures.name: get_assembly_bounding_box
tool_signatures.description: Get the bounding box of the whole assembly (min/max/size in mm).

tool_signatures.name: get_bounding_box
tool_signatures.description: Get the tight bounding box of the current part (min/max/size in mm).

tool_signatures.name: get_mass_properties
tool_signatures.description: Get volume (mm^3), mass (kg), surface area (mm^2), centre of mass, and bounding box.

tool_signatures.name: get_status
tool_signatures.description: Report whether SolidWorks is reachable, its revision, this server's version, and the active/current part.

tool_signatures.name: insert_component
tool_signatures.description: Insert a .sldprt, or a .sldasm as a sub-assembly, with its ORIGIN at (x, y, z) mm.

tool_signatures.name: list_bodies
tool_signatures.description: List the part's solid bodies: name, volume and bounding box.

tool_signatures.name: list_components
tool_signatures.description: List the assembly's components (name, path, fixed, position, rotation, bounding box) and mates.

tool_signatures.name: list_dimensions
tool_signatures.description: List every dimension in the current part: name (for set_dimension), feature, value, unit.

tool_signatures.name: list_documents
tool_signatures.description: List the documents open in SolidWorks: title, path (empty until saved), type, unsaved changes.

tool_signatures.name: list_edges
tool_signatures.description: List the part's edges: index, type, length, ends; lines also axis and midpoint.

tool_signatures.name: list_equations
tool_signatures.description: List the equations and global variables: index, equation, name it sets, value, global.

tool_signatures.name: list_faces
tool_signatures.description: List the part's faces (index, planar?, normal, area, centre) for inspection.

tool_signatures.name: list_features
tool_signatures.description: List the current part's modelling history in tree order: name, type, suppressed.

tool_signatures.name: make_drawing
tool_signatures.description: Make a 2D drawing of the current part: a PDF, or an editable .slddrw.

tool_signatures.name: measure_distance
tool_signatures.description: The smallest distance (mm) from a component to another one, a point or an axis.

tool_signatures.name: new_assembly
tool_signatures.description: Create a new empty assembly document; it becomes the current document.

tool_signatures.name: new_part
tool_signatures.description: Create a new empty part document; it becomes the current part.

tool_signatures.name: open_assembly
tool_signatures.description: Open a .sldasm, or import a STEP/IGES/Parasolid assembly; it becomes the current document.

tool_signatures.name: open_part
tool_signatures.description: Open a .sldprt, or import a STEP/IGES/Parasolid file as a new part; it becomes the current part.

tool_signatures.name: read_sketch
tool_signatures.description: Read a sketch of the current part back, e.g. one a person drew (a list_features name).

tool_signatures.name: rebuild
tool_signatures.description: Force a rebuild of the current part or assembly and report whether it rebuilt without errors.

tool_signatures.name: reorder_feature
tool_signatures.description: Move a feature (a list_features name), with its sketch, to just before another one; rebuild and remeasure.

tool_signatures.name: save_assembly
tool_signatures.description: Save the current assembly to a native .sldasm file (so it can be reopened).

tool_signatures.name: save_part
tool_signatures.description: Save the current part to a native .sldprt file (so it can be reopened/edited).

tool_signatures.name: screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Save a screenshot of the current part or assembly (PNG/JPG/TIF).

tool_signatures.name: set_appearance
tool_signatures.description: Colour and/or see-through of the current part, or of one component in an assembly.

tool_signatures.name: set_component_transform
tool_signatures.description: Move/rotate a component: its origin to (x, y, z) mm, rotated rx/ry/rz degrees.

tool_signatures.name: set_dimension
tool_signatures.description: Set a named driving dimension (e.g. 'D1@BlockExtrude') in mm, rebuild, and remeasure.

tool_signatures.name: set_equation
tool_signatures.description: Add an equation, or replace the one that sets the same name; rebuild and remeasure.

tool_signatures.name: set_equations
tool_signatures.description: Add or replace a list of equations at once, with one rebuild at the end.

tool_signatures.name: set_material
tool_signatures.description: Assign a material by name (e.g. "6061 Alloy", "AISI 1020", "ABS").

tool_signatures.name: slice_mesh
tool_signatures.description: Cross-sections of an STL/3MF mesh at the given heights along axis 'x'/'y'/'z'.

tool_signatures.name: split_body
tool_signatures.description: Split the part's body in two along a plane (front/top/right or a plane by name).

tool_signatures.name: suppress_feature
tool_signatures.description: Suppress a feature, or bring it back with suppress=False; rebuild and remeasure.

tool_signatures.name: suppress_mate
tool_signatures.description: Suppress a mate so it stops holding its components (it stays in the tree), or bring it back.

tool_signatures.name: swept_region
tool_signatures.description: Outline what a component covers in a plane while a joint moves, to keep
